description: Valuation ranges per method on one shared horizontal axis, with a marker for the reference price. The axis is the slide's only coordinate system: every bar is a flex weight, so the component scales to any box without a number in EMU.

data_schema._id: instance id prefix, set by the slide

roles.band: computed when left out (see the report)
roles.marker: computed when left out (see the report)
roles.label: type.body
roles.caption: computed when left out (see the report)
roles.marker_label: computed when left out (see the report)

size_domain_emu.height_rule: data['variant'] when given; otherwise wide when every row label wraps to at most params.max_label_lines in the label column (measured with guide['_api']) and the measured rows, marker line, axis and tick line fit the box height, the box is at least params.wide_min_width_emu wide and the value column at most params.value_share_max of it; otherwise compact

variants.wide: label column beside the bars, value column after them
variants.compact: label with the value above each bar, the thinner bar role

single_line_rule: tick labels, value captions and the marker label must stay on one line in every test box; component.py check fails otherwise
marker: a params.marker_width_pt rule in roles.marker (default: the first accent that reads 3:1 on color.surface) at the marker value, in the label row and inside every bar row (cut out of the band where it crosses it)
